title: Implement a reproducible persistent design tracer bullet
description: Implement the user-authorized review remediation: explicit v1 contract, persistent propose/evaluate/decide/replay CLI, independent payment-storage fixtures, derived views and safe export rejection, evidence-producing tracer command, and validation. Preserve historical bundle and document unavailable archives/human study honestly.

title: Verify archive merge and recovery safety in an isolated integration fixture
description: Findings F05 in openspec/reviews/2026-10-13-design-evaluation.md. Pin compatible Specodelic/OpenSpec revisions and exercise additive merge, historical replay and interrupted multi-file writes. Inspect the confirmed verbatim-copy path. Preserve unrelated requirements and reject unsafe writes; no mutation of real accepted specs during experiments.

title: Define the payment-storage pilot oracle and finite evaluation boundaries
description: Findings F04, F08, F13, F15 in openspec/reviews/2026-10-13-design-evaluation.md. Define exact states, traces and observation mapping for payment, durable commit and shipment eligibility. Include successful shipping and failure/crash cases, boundedness/vacuity/hiding rules, resource limits, and implementation-evidence scope.

title: Specify workspace authority, action contracts, and durable evidence semantics
description: Findings F02, F03, F06, F07 in openspec/reviews/2026-10-13-design-evaluation.md. Define schema and semantic digest policy, actor trust and field ownership, external-drift detection, typed transitions and errors, persistent commit/recovery, obligation discharge and evidence invalidation. Include golden transition and crash-recovery fixtures.

title: Restore reproducible source inputs for the VSD baseline
description: Findings F01, F15 in openspec/reviews/2026-10-13-design-evaluation.md. Publish immutable retrieval locations or checked-in baseline inputs matching manifest hashes; record dependencies, commands, results, and Python/Rust reuse boundary. A clean checkout must reproduce G0 without conversation context.

title: Turn the selected VSD slice into traceable implementation-ready change specs
description: Findings F10, F11, F12, F14 in openspec/reviews/2026-10-13-design-evaluation.md. Map mandatory requirements to exact positive, negative and boundary fixtures; reconcile SHOULD requirements with release gates; define vague qualifiers; fill project conventions and resolve the unapproved configuration layout. Keep research bundle provenance intact and use OpenSpec change specs for the selected implementation slice.

title: Measure workspace and visual-interface value against the current review workflow
description: Findings F09 in openspec/reviews/2026-10-13-design-evaluation.md. Identify pilot maintainers and compare seeded review tasks against existing OpenSpec/text workflows. Agree adoption and usability criteria before testing; measure total modeling/review effort, missed defects, false alarms, and bounded-evidence comprehension. Evaluate interactive diagrams separately.

title: Evaluate design contract, value proposition, feasibility, and gaps
description: Review the committed VSD design bundle against repository implementation and externally verified technical feasibility. Produce an evidence-backed evaluation with prioritized gaps and durable follow-up work.
notes: Evaluation recorded in openspec/reviews/2026-10-13-design-evaluation.md: NEEDS_REVISION, 4 critical/8 high/3 medium findings. just ci passed (3 scaffold tests); five bundle hashes matched; OpenSpec found no items to validate.
